The [iNaturalist Network](https://www.naturalista.uy/sites/network) is a localised experience that is fully connected to the global iNaturalist community. Network members are local institutions that promote local use and facilitate the use of data from iNaturalist to benefit local 

The aim of this report is to give an account of the importance of the iNaturalist network members by analysing the number of records for each country.

## iNaturalist National Sites

```{r}
#| label: inat-sites
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| tbl-cap: 'Members of the iNaturalist Network. Shown in green are the sites from Latin America'

inat_network <- read_csv('data/inat_nodes.csv', na='')

inat_network %>% 
  mutate('#'= row_number()) %>% relocate('#') %>% 
  rename(`Country` = node_country,
         `Node name` = node_name,
         `ID`= node_id,
         `Type`=node_type,
         `Year established` = node_year) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=1) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') %>% 
  kableExtra::row_spec(row = c(1,4,7,8,10,11,12,17,21), bold = T, color = "white", background = "#228A22")
```

```{r}
  theme(
    legend.position = 'bottom',

    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank()   
  )
```

## Methods

We tested different explanatory variables and saw which is the model that best explains the values a country has for iNaturalist. Indicators per country were extracted using the WDI: World Development Indicators (World Bank) on the **20th of March, 2026**. 

**Response variables** (per country):  

  - `n_records`: total number of records on iNaturalist.  
  - `n_users`: number of users recording (this is not exactly the users *from* the country, but users that have generated records in the country).  
  - `n_species`: number of species recorded (this is not necessarily at the species level).
  - `n_projects`: number of projects created.
  - `p_research_grade`: proportion of records from iNaturalist that are "Research Grade" (proxy for quality).  
  - `n_literature`: number of peer-reviewed publications in GBIF using iNat data.  

**Explanatory variables**:  

  - `population`: population of the country (*SP.POP.TOTL*).  
  - `area`: area of the country in km^2^ (*AG.SRF.TOTL.K2*).  
  - `gdp_per_capita`: GDP per capita in US dollars (*NY.GDP.PCAP.CD*).  
  - `gdp_in_research`: % of the GDP of the country dedicated to research *GB.XPD.RSDV.GD.ZS*).  
  - `latitude`: country's centroid latitude (as a proxy of expected biodiversity) (using `rnaturalearth` country polygons).  
  - `iucn_species`: number of species reported for the country on IUCN (using `rnaturalearth` country polygons).  
  - `has_node`: whether a country has a node on the iNaturalist network.   
  - `neighbour_has_node`: whether a country has a neighbouring country that has a node on the iNaturalist network (using `rnaturalearth` country polygons).  

### Data 

We downloaded the data following

```{r}
#| label: variables
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data_variables <- read_csv('data/data_global_variables.csv', na = '')
```


## Summary of the data

```{r}
#| label: summary-data
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

summary_data <- data_variables %>% 
  mutate(is_network =
           case_when(!is.na(node_name) ~ 'Network',
                     country_name == 'United States' ~ 'United States',
                     .default = 'Rest of the world')) %>%
  relocate(is_network) %>%
  group_by(is_network) %>% 
  summarise(n_records = sum(n_records, na.rm = T), 
            n_users = sum(n_users, na.rm = T), 
            n_species = sum(n_species, na.rm = T), 
            n_projects = sum(n_projects, na.rm = T), 
            n_literature = sum(n_literature, na.rm = T), 
            p_research_grade_mean = round(mean(p_research_grade, na.rm = T),3),
            p_research_grade_sd = round(sd(p_research_grade, na.rm = T),3))

summary_data %>%
  mutate(perc_records = round(n_records*100/sum(n_records),1), .after = n_records) %>%
  mutate(perc_users = round(n_users*100/sum(n_users),1), .after = n_users) %>%
  mutate(perc_species = round(n_species*100/sum(n_species),1), .after = n_species) %>%
  mutate(perc_projects = round(n_projects*100/sum(n_projects),1), .after = n_projects) %>%
  mutate(perc_literature = round(n_literature*100/sum(n_literature),1), .after = n_literature) %>%
  janitor::adorn_totals('row', ,,, n_records, n_users, n_species, n_projects, n_literature) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(col.names = c('Network', 'Observations', '(%)',
                                'Users', '(%)',
                                'Species', '(%)',
                                'Projects', '(%)',
                                'Publications', '(%)',
                                'Proportion of RG', 'sd'),
                  digits=3, format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>% 
  kableExtra::scroll_box()

  
summary_plot_n_records <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_records, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000))) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of records') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

summary_plot_n_users <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_users, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000))) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of users') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

summary_plot_n_species <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_species, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000)), 
                     limits = c(0,1500000)) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of species') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

summary_plot_n_projects <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_projects, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000)), 
                     limits = c(0,60000)) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of projects') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

summary_plot_n_literature <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=n_literature, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = c(m = 1000000)), 
                     limits = c(0,2500)) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Number of publications') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()


summary_plot_p_research_grade_mean <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x=is_network)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y=p_research_grade_mean, fill=is_network),
           stat = 'identity',
           show.legend = F) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#74AC00',  '#b2b2b2ff', 'black')) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  labs(x = '', y = 'Proportion of Research Grade records') +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean()

(summary_plot_n_records + summary_plot_n_users) / (summary_plot_n_species + summary_plot_n_projects) / (summary_plot_n_literature + summary_plot_p_research_grade_mean) 
```

## Summary of the data for the Network members

```{r}
#| label: site-variables
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data_variables %>% filter(!is.na(node_name)) %>% 
  select(country_name, node_name, 
         n_records, p_research_grade, 
         n_users, n_species, n_projects,n_literature) %>% 
  arrange(country_name, n_records) %>% 
  rename(Country=country_name,
         Node=node_name, 
         `Observations`= n_records,
         `% Research Grade` = p_research_grade,
         `Users`= n_users,
         `Species`= n_species,
         `Projects`= n_projects,
         `Literature`= n_literature) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=3, format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') 
```

### Number of records on iNaturalist

```{r}
#| label: n_inat_country
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

ids <- data_variables %>% 
  select(country_name,node_name, n_records) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_records)) %>% 
  with(which(!is.na(node_name)))

data_variables %>% 
  select(country_name,node_name, n_records) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_records)) %>% 
  mutate('#'= row_number()) %>% relocate('#') %>% 
  rename(`Country` = country_name,
         `Node` = node_name,
         `Observations`=n_records) %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=4, format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') %>% 
  kableExtra::row_spec(ids, bold = T, color = "white", background = "#228A22") %>%

```

### Population of the country

```{r}
#| echo: true

## records
ggplot(data_variables %>% mutate(has_node = as.character(has_node)), 
       aes(population/100000, n_records/1000, label = node_name)) +
```

## Modelling

```{r}
#| label: data-regressions
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| out-width: 100%

data_regressions <- data_variables %>%
  select(-c(country_name, region, flag, node_name, node_id, node_type, node_year, place_id)) %>%
  drop_na(area, population, gdp_per_capita, gdp_in_research, latitude, iucn_species) %>%
  filter(country_code != 'US')


###

data_regressions %>% 
  select(area, population, gdp_per_capita,
         gdp_in_research, latitude, iucn_species, 
         has_node, neighbour_has_node) %>% 
  cor() %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(digits=3, 
                  format.args = list(big.mark = ',')) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_material('striped') 

data_regressions %>% 
  select(area, population, gdp_per_capita,
         gdp_in_research, latitude, iucn_species, 
         has_node, neighbour_has_node) %>% 
  cor() %>% 
  corrplot::corrplot(method = 'color',
                     diag = FALSE, type = 'lower',
                     order = 'AOE', tl.col = 'grey15') 

data_regressions %>% 
  select(area, population, gdp_per_capita,
         gdp_in_research, latitude, iucn_species) %>% 
  cor() %>% 
  caret::findCorrelation(., cutoff=0.65, names=T)

data_regressions %>% 
  select(area, population, gdp_per_capita,
         gdp_in_research, latitude, iucn_species) %>% pairs()
```

Number of countries analysed: `r nrow(data_regressions)`.

## GLM

### Standardise predictors and outcomes

These steps are the same as for the random forests

  - Log transform (`log10`) and scale response (mean zero).  
  - Log transform (`log10`) and scale predictors (mean zero).  
  - Convert `latitude` to absolute latitude.  
  - Convert `has_node` and `neighbour_has_node` to factor.

```{r}
#| label: standr-outcomes-glm
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# variables that need to be log transformed
data_regressions %>%
  select(where(is.numeric) & 
           where(~max(., na.rm = TRUE) > 1000)) %>% 
    summary()

data_glm <- data_regressions %>% 
  mutate(n_records = scale(log10(n_records))[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(n_users = scale(log10(n_users))[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(n_species = scale(log10(n_species))[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(n_projects = scale(log10(n_projects))[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(n_literature = scale(n_literature)[,1])

data_glm <- data_glm %>% 
  mutate(area = scale(log10(area))[,1],
         population = scale(log10(population))[,1],
         gdp_per_capita = scale(log10(gdp_per_capita))[,1],
         latitude = scale(abs(latitude))[,1],
         iucn_species = scale(log10(iucn_species))[,1],
         has_node = as.factor(has_node),
         neighbour_has_node = as.factor(neighbour_has_node))

data_glm$has_node <- relevel(factor(data_glm$has_node), ref = "0")
data_glm$neighbour_has_node <- relevel(factor(data_glm$neighbour_has_node), ref = "0")
```

### Linear models

```{r}
#| label: lm-models
#| echo: true

lm_n_records <- lm(n_records ~ 
                        area + population + 
                        gdp_per_capita + gdp_in_research + 
                        latitude + iucn_species +
                        has_node + neighbour_has_node,
                      data = data_glm)

lm_n_users <- lm(n_users ~ 
                        area + population + 
                        gdp_per_capita + gdp_in_research + 
                        latitude + iucn_species +
                        has_node + neighbour_has_node,
                      data = data_glm)

lm_n_species <- lm(n_species ~ 
                        area + population + 
                        gdp_per_capita + gdp_in_research + 
                        latitude + iucn_species +
                        has_node + neighbour_has_node,
                      data = data_glm)

lm_n_projects <- lm(n_projects ~ 
                        area + population + 
                        gdp_per_capita + gdp_in_research + 
                        latitude + iucn_species +
                        has_node + neighbour_has_node,
                      data = data_glm)

lm_p_research_grade <- lm(p_research_grade ~ 
                        area + population + 
                        gdp_per_capita + gdp_in_research + 
                        latitude + iucn_species +
                        has_node + neighbour_has_node,
                      data = data_glm)

lm_n_literature <- lm(n_literature ~ 
                        area + population + 
                        gdp_per_capita + gdp_in_research + 
                        latitude + iucn_species +
                        has_node + neighbour_has_node,
                      data = data_glm)
```

### Model estimates

```{r}
#| label: lm-model-estimates
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

tidy_models <- bind_rows(
  tidy(lm_n_records, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Number of records"),
  tidy(lm_n_users, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Number of users"),
  tidy(lm_n_species, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Number of species"),
  tidy(lm_n_projects, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Number of projects"),
  tidy(lm_p_research_grade,  conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Proportion of research grade"),  
  tidy(lm_n_literature, conf.int = TRUE) %>% 
    mutate(model = "Number of publications")) %>%
  # drop intercept rows
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  # add significance markers
  mutate(
    sig_stars = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""),
    is_sig = p.value < 0.05,
    # relevel variables
    model = fct_relevel(
      model,
      "Number of records",
      "Number of users",
      "Number of species",
      "Number of projects",
      "Proportion of research grade",
      "Number of publications"),
    term = fct_relevel(
      term,
      "neighbour_has_node1",
      "has_node1",
      "latitude",
      "iucn_species",
      "gdp_in_research",
      "gdp_per_capita",
      "population",
      "area"))

tidy_models %>% 
  relocate(model) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)

tidy_models %>% filter(term=='has_node1')  %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

### Marginal effects

```{r}
#| label: marginal-effect
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

effect_df <- function(model, model_name, 
                      term = "has_node", 
                      relabel = TRUE) {
  e <- effects::Effect(term, model, se = TRUE)
  df <- as.data.frame(e)
  if (relabel) {
    df[[term]] <- factor(df[[term]], levels = c("0","1"),
                         labels = c("No node","Has node"))
  }
  df$model <- model_name
  df
}

eff_list <- list(
  effect_df(lm_n_records, "Number of records"),
  effect_df(lm_n_users, "Number of users"),
  effect_df(lm_n_species, "Number of species"),
  effect_df(lm_n_projects, "Number of projects"),
  effect_df(lm_p_research_grade, "Proportion of research grade"),
  effect_df(lm_n_literature, "Number of publications"))

eff_all <- bind_rows(eff_list) %>%
  mutate(model = fct_relevel(model,
                             "Number of records",
                             "Number of users",
                             "Number of species",
                             "Number of projects",
                             "Proportion of research grade",
                             "Number of publications"))

stars_by_model <- list(
  "Number of records" = lm_n_records,
  "Number of users" = lm_n_users,
  "Number of species" = lm_n_species,
  "Number of projects" = lm_n_projects,
  "Proportion of research grade" = lm_p_research_grade,
  "Number of publications" = lm_n_literature) %>%
  imap_dfr(~ tidy(.x) %>%
             filter(grepl("^has_node", term)) %>%
             transmute(model = .y,
                       star = case_when(
                         p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                         p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                         p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                         p.value < 0.1   ~ "•",
                         TRUE            ~ "")))

# join onto effect dataframe and annotate "Has node"
eff_all_star <- eff_all %>%
  left_join(stars_by_model, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(star = replace_na(star, "")) %>% 
  mutate(model = fct_relevel(
      model,
      "Number of records",
      "Number of users",
      "Number of species",
      "Number of projects",
      "Number of publications",
      "Proportion of research grade"))

pos <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

plot_lm_main_effects <- ggplot(eff_all_star,
       aes(x = has_node, 
           y = fit, color = has_node)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = pos,show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
                width = 0,linewidth = 1, position = pos,
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    data = subset(eff_all_star, 
                  has_node == "Has node" & star != ""),
    aes(label = star),
    position = pos,
    hjust = -1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 3, scales = 'fixed') +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#454545', '#74AC00')) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Partial effect") +
  ggpubr::theme_pubclean() 

plot_lm_main_effects


eff_all_star %>% relocate(model) %>%  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
    select(-c(n_records, p_research_grade, n_users, n_species, n_projects, n_literature)),

data_temporal_lm <- data_temporal_records %>% 
  mutate(area = scale(log10(area))[,1],
         population = scale(log10(population))[,1],

         has_node = as.factor(has_node),

         n_records_years = scale(log10(n_records_years+1))[,1])

data_temporal_lm$year_c <- data_temporal_lm$year - mean(data_temporal_lm$year)
data_temporal_lm$has_node <- relevel(factor(data_temporal_lm$has_node), ref = "0")
data_temporal_lm$neighbour_has_node <- relevel(factor(data_temporal_lm$neighbour_has_node), ref = "0")
```

```{r}
# Null model (random effect only)
m0_records <- lmer(n_records_years ~ year_c + (1 | country_name),
```

## Before and after the node

- `node_year`: the year in which a country's national node was officially established (e.g., 2021 for Uruguay's NaturalistaUY).   
- `years_since_node`: the number of years between the assessed year and the node's establishment year, calculated as `year - node_year`. This is negative for years before the node existed, zero in the year of establishment, and positive for years after.
- `post_node`: a binary indicator equal to `1` if the assessed year is greater than or equal to `node_year` (i.e., the node already existed that year), and `0` otherwise.   

### Number of records

```{r}
#| label: before-and-after-records
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data_before_after_records <- left_join(node_years,
          data_temporal_records %>%
            select(country_name, node_name, year, n_records_years)) %>% 
  mutate(years_since_node = year - node_year,
         post_node = ifelse(year >= node_year, 1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(n_records_years = scale(log10(n_records_years+1))[,1])

data_before_after_records %>% 
  filter(country_name=='Uruguay') %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)

```

```{r}
#| label: before-and-after-records-model
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
n_records_before_after <- lmer(n_records_years ~ years_since_node * post_node + (1 + years_since_node | country_name), data = data_before_after_records)

summary(n_records_before_after)$call
performance::performance(n_records_before_after)
tab_model(n_records_before_after)

pred <- ggpredict(n_records_before_after, terms = c("years_since_node", "post_node"))

# ggplot(data_before_after_records, 
#        aes(x = years_since_node, y = n_records_years, group = country_name)) +
#   geom_line(alpha = 0.5, color = "grey50") +
#   geom_line(data = pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, group = NULL), 
#             color = "#74AC00", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
#   geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
#   labs(x = "Years since node establishment", y = "Number of records") +
#   theme_minimal()

ggplot(data_before_after_records, aes(x = years_since_node, y = n_records_years)) +
  geom_line(col='#74AC00') +
  geom_point(col='#74AC00') +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  facet_wrap(~ country_name, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(x = "Years since node establishment", y = "Number of records") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Test with all countries (not just the network members) using an arbitrary break-point 

```{r}

break_point <- 2019

data_before_after_records_all <- data_temporal_records %>%
  select(country_name, node_name, year, n_records_years, has_node) %>% 
  mutate(year_break_point = year - break_point,
         post_break = ifelse(year >= break_point, 1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(n_records_years = scale(log10(n_records_years+1))[,1])


data_before_after_records_all %>% 
  filter(country_name=='Uruguay') %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)

n_records_before_after_all <- lmer(n_records_years ~ has_node * year_break_point * post_break + 
                                 (1 + year_break_point | country_name),
                               data = data_before_after_records_all)

summary(n_records_before_after_all)$call
performance::performance(n_records_before_after_all)
tab_model(n_records_before_after_all)

pred <- ggpredict(n_records_before_after_all, terms = c("year_break_point", "post_break", "has_node"))

ggplot(data_before_after_records_all, 
       aes(x = year_break_point, y = n_records_years, group = country_name)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1, aes(col = as.factor(has_node))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('black','#74AC00')) +
  # geom_line(data = pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted), 
  #           linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE, color='red') +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Years before breakpoint (2019)", y = "Number of records", col='Has node') +
  theme_minimal()

```
